abstract: Mature cystic teratomas are benign unilateral tumors often diagnosed in young females. Carcinoid tumors are slow-growing tumors originating from neuroendocrine cells. A thorough histopathological study of the tumor is mandatory and the surgical treatment is adapted according to the characteristics of the patient. The present case was considered as a primary mucinous carcinoid tumor of the ovary because it was confined to the ovary, had an intact capsule, no vascular invasion, or other suspicious lesions were noted in the abdominal cavity. This case is notable due to the rarity of its occurrence and the age of presentation.
abstract_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫は、若年女性に多く診断される良性の片側性腫瘍である。カルチノイド腫瘍は、神経内分泌細胞由来の増殖の遅い腫瘍である。腫瘍の詳細な組織病理学的検討が必須であり、外科的治療は患者の特徴に応じて選択される。本症例は、卵巣内に限局し、被膜が保たれており、血管浸潤や腹腔内の他の疑わしい病変が認められなかったため、原発性粘液性カルチノイド腫瘍と考えられた。本症例は、その発生の稀少性と発症年齢の点で注目に値する。
